page.notes: Running title "INDEX X." is printed at the top, centred, and is treated as the running head. Catchword "Mauritij" at lower right. The Greek phrase in "Mariae & Christi" line could not be read and is marked illegible. Several entries are uncertain: "Magistratui debitus honos" (147.a) and "Marcelli Epifcopi Apamenensis factū" are read from a faint scan, and "Liber verborum dierum qui sit" with "181.b" continuation is a split entry. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Liberas Salomonis", "Lignorum ex Vitruuio iudiciu", "Maioritatis Romanae doctrinam non uam esse", "Libri Actorum ... 93 a", "Libertas dicendi ... 202 a", "Leuitae ludaeis", "Mala etiam", "Manasfis aetas,genus, aêta". The small mark under "Libidinis proprium" at lower left is not treated as a signature.
